# Omar Tood

> Omar Tood (full name Omar Jibril Abdulkadir) is a machine learning engineer
> and AI researcher based in Mogadishu, Somalia. He works on large language
> models, agentic systems, and natural language processing for the Somali
> language.

## Facts

- Full name: Omar Jibril Abdulkadir. Known professionally as Omar Tood.
- Role: Instructor and researcher at Goobo Labs, an open Somali AI research lab.
- Education: BSc in Computer Science, Jamhuriya University of Science and
  Technology. MSc in Artificial Intelligence, Hormuud University.
- Location: Mogadishu, Banaadir, Somalia.
- Languages: Somali, English.
- Focus areas: large language models, agentic AI, natural language processing,
  low-resource language technology, open datasets, tokenization.
- Notable work: SomNLP-Corpus, the largest open Somali text corpus; Soplang,
  the first Somali programming language; the Somali Language Standard (SLS);
  free Data Science and Machine Learning bootcamps run through Goobo Labs.

## Why the work exists

Somali is spoken by more than 20 million people and holds an almost invisible
share of the data that trains modern AI. Omar Tood's work is aimed at closing
that gap through open datasets, Somali-native models, and free training.
